quotes.speaker: Scoot Henderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Scoot Henderson on his aggressive play and team contribution

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: How'd you think you did tonight?

text_blocks.speaker: Scoot Henderson
text_blocks.text: I feel like I did all right. Just trying to be aggressive on both sides of the ball, doing what I need to help the team win.

quotes.speaker: Scoot Henderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Scoot Henderson on the team's slow start and his personal challenge
quotes.excerpt: I'm not going to back down from the challenge. Just continue to be the best version of myself

text_blocks.speaker: Scoot Henderson
text_blocks.text: I feel like a slow start, but I'm not going to back down from the challenge. Just continue to be the best version of myself every night. Shots not falling doesn't mean I stop playing ball.

quotes.social_post: Scoot Henderson on the Blazers slow start: I feel like a slow start, but I am not going to back down from the challenge. Shots not falling does not mean I stop playing ball.

structured.context: Scoot Henderson discusses his mindset regarding the team's slow start to the season and his personal performance.

quotes.speaker: Scoot Henderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Scoot Henderson on maturing and not overthinking his game
quotes.excerpt: I feel like now I've matured enough to tell myself it's not that serious, just continue to play my game

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: In those early games, I could almost just see you wanting it so bad and trying so hard. Do you feel like you were overthinking?

text_blocks.speaker: Scoot Henderson
text_blocks.text: I feel back to doing that. I feel like I used to do that, and then I feel like now I've matured enough to tell myself it's not that serious, just continue to play my game.

quotes.social_post: Scoot Henderson says he is maturing and learning to stop overthinking his game: I have matured enough to tell myself it is not that serious, just continue to play my game.

structured.context: Scoot Henderson explains his maturation process and his effort to stop overthinking his game.

quotes.speaker: Scoot Henderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Scoot Henderson on the impact of coach Michael on the team
quotes.excerpt: having a coach like Michael is great, man. Just have a confidence in every single one of us

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: How about what coach says? He tells you not to overthink sometimes. Does that register with you?

text_blocks.speaker: Scoot Henderson
text_blocks.text: Oh yeah. Having a coach like Michael is great, man. Just have a confidence in every single one of us, not just me, but every single one of us. Same thing that he's saying to me, same thing he's saying to everybody else.

quotes.social_post: Scoot Henderson praises coach Michael for his impact on the team: Having a coach like Michael is great. He has confidence in every single one of us.

structured.context: Scoot Henderson discusses the impact of coach Michael on his confidence and the team.

quotes.speaker: Scoot Henderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Scoot Henderson on his relationship with coach Michael
quotes.excerpt: it's almost like a kind of OG, kind of relationship

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: How would you describe your two's conversations?

text_blocks.speaker: Scoot Henderson
text_blocks.text: It's like a, I say, I don't want to say big bro because out of respect for him, but it's almost like a kind of OG, kind of relationship where obviously it's a few months in, but the moment he's came in, he's been on that just, appreciate you, and it's vice versa from me.

quotes.social_post: Scoot Henderson describes his relationship with coach Michael as an OG kind of relationship where there is mutual appreciation.

structured.context: Scoot Henderson describes his relationship with coach Michael as being like an OG mentor.

quotes.speaker: Scoot Henderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Scoot Henderson on his opportunity to start while Scoot is out
quotes.excerpt: opportunity for me to be on the floor any given night is a great opportunity

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: How big is this opportunity for you to be starting for the next few weeks while Jaz is out?

text_blocks.speaker: Scoot Henderson
text_blocks.text: It's a great opportunity. Opportunity for me to be on the floor any given night is a great opportunity, whether I'm starting off the bench. I'm not here to kind of fill up somebody's spot, I'm here to be the best version of myself.

quotes.social_post: Scoot Henderson on his opportunity to start while teammates are out: I am not here to fill up somebody's spot, I am here to be the best version of myself.

structured.context: Scoot Henderson addresses his opportunity to start while teammate Jaz is sidelined with an injury.
